Barbed
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Barbed"** means having or covered with protective **points, spines, or thorns; **also, it can mean a **remark **or comment that is** cutting or hurtf**ul. (कांटेदार या चुभने वाला)

 
 
• **Example:** He made a** barbed** comment about her appearance that left her feeling hurt.
 
 
 
• **"Spiteful"** means showing or caused by **malice; intending to harm or upset someone**. (द्वेषपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** She made a **spiteful** remark, intending to hurt his feelings.
 
 

Therefore, the correct synonym of '**Barbed'** is** 'Spiteful.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Passive** (निष्क्रिय): Accepting or allowing what happens or what others do, without active response or resistance.

 
 
• **Example:** He remained **passive** during the argument, not wanting to escalate the situation.
 
 
 
• **Kind** (दयालु): Having or showing a friendly, generous, and considerate nature.
 
 
• **Example:** She is a **kind **person who always helps those in need.
 
 
 
• **Gentle** (मृदु): Having or showing a mild, kind, or tender temperament or character.
 
 
• **Example:** He has a **gentle **voice that is very soothing to listen to.
